_comment: Human-approved alias resolutions. Decisions as data, with approver and evidence. Any name a machine cannot resolve is FLAGGED, never guessed; a human ruling is recorded here and becomes the written trail. Pattern approved 2026-07-28. roster_admissions records teams ADMITTED to a roster-locked state by league authority; alias decisions resolve NAMES, admissions add MEMBERS. merges records duplicate team rows collapsed by human ruling; alias decisions resolve NAMES, admissions add MEMBERS, merges remove DUPLICATES. KEEPER RULE: in a merge, the keeper is the row that CARRIES MORE — seasons, games, ranking entries, provenance — never the row that happened to be created first or by a particular source. brophy_az (kept the a7 row) and blanchet_wa (kept the export row) are worked examples pointing in opposite directions. do_not_merge records pairs a human has ruled DISTINCT; scripts/reconcile-placeholders.js reads it and suppresses them, so a rejected candidate is never re-proposed.

roster_admissions.name: Vashon

evidence: appears in Brandon Fortier's official WHSBLA 2027 draft classification file

no 2026 rows anywhere — Vashon was not a 2026 member
roster_admissions.reversal_rule: if the October final list drops Vashon, it is removed the same way it arrived — by league authority

merges.basis: same school reached from two directions by two sources; pre-dates the roster lock
evidence: Brophy College Preparatory, Phoenix AZ — universally shortened to 'Brophy Prep'
brophy_az seeded from a7-classification.json as an OREGON opponent, name 'Brophy College Prep'
brophy_prep_az seeded from the WHSBLA 2026 export as a WASHINGTON opponent, name 'Brophy Prep'
both rows are state=AZ; neither has team_seasons or ranking_entries
brophy_az holds the only game reference (Sunset @ Brophy College Prep, 2026-03-21)
merges.keep_rationale: brophy_az holds the game FK and carries the school's full canonical name
merges.note: Non-curated states have no roster lock, so nothing prevented this. Merging is a prerequisite gate before AZ rankings are ever enabled.

merges.basis: same school reached from two directions; pre-dates the roster lock
evidence: Bishop Blanchet High School, Seattle — the WHSBLA export lists it as 'Blanchet'
bishop_blanchet_wa seeded from a7-classification as an OREGON opponent (Lake Oswego/Riverdale @ Bishop Blanchet, canonical_source=ohsla)
blanchet_wa seeded from the WHSBLA 2026 export as a MEMBER: 6 league games, wa_private for 2026 AND 2027, 1 ranking entry
the a7 row has no team_seasons at all
merges.keep_rationale: blanchet_wa carries far more — 6 games vs 1, two seasons vs none, a ranking row vs none
merges.note: Direction is OPPOSITE to the brophy merge, deliberately. See the keeper rule.

do_not_merge.reason: distinct schools; the sweep's generic-word stripping ('prep', 'academy') collides them
evidence: Seattle Preparatory and Seattle Academy are separate Seattle schools
Seattle Prep is the 2026 PV/Open champion in our own bracket data (beat Bellevue 14-13 OT at Starfire)
both carry seasons=2 rank=1 — both were adopted cleanly at import
runner-up match from the same sweep; recorded so it is never re-proposed
